vacancy.title: Micro-Electronics Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Newly discovered direct ESTEC contractor role. Requires electronics/physics MSc and 5+ years across DSP, ASIC/FPGA design and verification, HDL tools and lab characterisation. Work supports ESA digital microelectronics R&D, qualification and verification. Valuable ESTEC placement but very limited match to mechanical/thermal/optomechanical background; specialist stretch. Official SSC deadline 15 Nov 2026.
